attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"the Rim Dispatch has pulled its reporters back from Lowmere","reason":"Briefing says it stopped sending reporters toward Lowmere, not that it withdrew reporters already there."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"It copies the briefing's section headings ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported:') into the bulletin, which breaks the format. It also buries the missing reporter, the most striking item, at the end. The wry voice barely appears, and 'pulled back' slightly changes what the briefing says."}
